The '''Melford Star Academy''', also called the '''First Star Academy''' or simply the '''Imperial Naval Academy''', was a branch of the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]] located on [[Melford]], a [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] [[City/Legends|city]] situated on the northern coast of [[Anai]].
